text: 你准备离开哈里斯家，觉得自己在这里要办的事已经结束。你在门口停了一会儿，考虑下一步该做什么。你知道自己在哈里斯家待了很久，尽管浓雾让你看不清时间，你猜白昼所剩无几。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 222
text: You get ready to leave the Harris household, as you feel your business here is concluded. You pause at the door a moment to consider what your next step should be. You know you spent a good deal of time at the Harris place, and though the fog prevents you from making out the time of day, you imagine there’s not much daylight left.
